description: This file defines a Java class named 'Event' that is used to represent events within the Apache Fineract infrastructure, specifically related to hooks data. It includes Lombok annotations to generate boilerplate code and provides a static factory method for creating Event instances.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A final class representing an event within Fineract's hook infrastructure, implementing Serializable. It contains fields for action name and entity name, leveraging Lombok for boilerplate code and a static factory method for instantiation.
